brand.name: LANDLOGY
brand.tagline: We help property owners sell with research, verification and professional support.
brand.description: LANDLOGY is a real-estate service helping property owners sell their properties through research-backed pricing, verification, professional marketing and relevant buyer reach.

hero.h1: Sell your property at the right price.
hero.sub: From research-backed pricing and verification to professional marketing and closing support — LANDLOGY helps property owners sell with confidence. Tell us about your property and we will handle the rest.
hero.announce: Ready when you are. Free, no-obligation property assessment.

team.name: Shiva Singh
team.bio: Oversees the end-to-end selling journey for property owners — from initial assessment and positioning to negotiation and closing support. Focuses on translating market research into a clear, realistic path to sale.

team.name: Harshit Pandey
team.bio: Leads pricing analysis, location intelligence and demand assessment that inform how a property is positioned before it reaches the market. Helps owners understand current market conditions and realistic pricing windows.

team.name: Somesh Pandey
team.bio: Works with property owners to understand their selling objective and timeline, then coordinates the appropriate conversations within LANDLOGY's review process. Acts as the primary point of contact for owner enquiries.

team.name: Diwakar Dixit
team.bio: Handles property documentation, ownership validation and due-diligence workflows so owners can move ahead with clarity. Ensures property information is understood and organised before any presentation or outreach.

reviews.name: Deepak Malhotra
reviews.text: LANDLOGY didn’t just help us find a property — they did the research, verified the title and guided us through the entire transaction. First-time buyers couldn’t ask for more.

reviews.name: Neha Kapoor
reviews.text: As an NRI investor, finding verified commercial opportunities in India was always a challenge. LANDLOGY’s intelligence reports and due-diligence support made the entire process seamless.

reviews.name: Vikram Constructions
reviews.text: We partnered with LANDLOGY for land acquisition for our residential project in Pune. Their market research and local network saved us significant time and cost in site identification.
